verdict_reason: Present PE sits above both the Shiller PE and the historical median, at the high end of a thin 4-year band.
devils_advocate: FY082-083 EPS (7.65) is unaudited Q4 YTD, before the actuarial surplus transfer that lifted the prior two years' audited net profit by 43.8% and 47.5%. If FY082-083 sees the same adjustment, EPS could reach ~11 once audited, pulling Present PE to ~32-33 -- below the Shiller PE and median, flipping this to a cheap read.
